test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest on ₹550 for 8 months at 3 paise per rupee per month?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹550

Time (t) = 8 months

Rate (r) = 3 paise per rupee per month

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculations:**

Rate (R) in percentage = 3 paise per month = 3 × 12 paise per year = 36 paisa per year = 36%

Time (T) in years = 8/12 = 2/3 years

⇒ SI = dfrac{550 times 36 times dfrac{2}{3}}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{660}{5}

⇒ SI = 132

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**

54
